record_title: Exact FGM obstruction to unrestricted copula block substitution
provenance: SCOPE Phase II scientific record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Sharp obstruction for an FGM outer copula with an independence block and identity block; no classification of arbitrary block substitutions. The corrected differential operator is for a product inner block. Older nested-copula literature remains a residual originality risk for abstract equivalents.
